points: Plattner (Spiegel interview, via dts): major AI providers paid too little attention to security of their systems
Calls for provider accountability, possible liability, and a body that checks compliance
Wants technical identity for agents: what the AI is, who owns it, who commissioned it, what it may do
read: dts report on Spiegel interview, published on new-facts.eu
take: Germany's cyber agency head says voluntary pledges by US and Chinese AI providers are not enough and calls for regulation plus an oversight body.
title: BSI chief Plattner: AI providers neglect security, should be liable
